name: phase2_complex_scale
description: SCAFFOLD for a future higher-complexity scale-up phase. The dataset/model knobs below (cifar100, transformer_context_window, transformer_num_layers, diffusion_image_size, diffusion_base_channels) are not yet consumed by the experiment runners -- see 'implementation_status'. This file only captures the intended Phase 2 settings so the wiring can be added incrementally without re-deriving the target config from scratch.

classification_scale_up.notes: Requires extending get_dataloaders() in experiments/run_classification.py to add a cifar100 branch (torchvision.datasets.CIFAR100) and passing num_classes=100 into ResNet18(); an ImageNet-1k subset is a heavier alternative if CIFAR-100 saturates too quickly.

language_model_scale_up.notes: block_size (context window) is already an existing parameter of train_single_seed_lm; d_model/n_layers/n_heads are currently hardcoded MiniGPT class defaults (128/2/4) and are not yet threaded through as function/config parameters. alpha_lr/alpha_lr_warmup_epochs/alpha_grad_clip_norm/alpha_min/alpha_max intentionally override the shared Phase 1 alpha_lr_by_task.language_model=0.001 (equal to base_lr=1e-3), which destabilized alpha at 6 layers/d_model=256. alpha_lr=1e-4 (10x separation from base_lr) recovered 15.47 PPL on seed 42 but still trailed golu_static; alpha_lr=2e-5 (50x separation) plus a longer 4-epoch warmup is the current iteration -- see run_language_model_scale.py's _resolve_scale_recipe().

diffusion_scale_up.notes: DiffusionUNet currently hardcodes a 64-channel width and consumes CIFAR-10 at its native 32x32 resolution; both the resolution and base_channels would need to become constructor parameters wired through train_single_seed_diffusion before this config takes effect.

implementation_status: scaffold-only: no experiment runner currently reads classification_scale_up/language_model_scale_up/diffusion_scale_up. Wire them up incrementally, task by task, before pointing --config at this file for a real run.
